name: Receive the cash authority (NCA)
goal: The agency knows how much it may pay this month, and the bank holds the same limit.
alternate_courses: If the cash need is above the program, the agency asks for an additional NCA (diagram 05a, optional block) [NBC599] | An unused regular NCA lapses on the last working day of the quarter [NBC599]

name: Obligate and contract
goal: An obligation is recorded against the allotment, and the contract or purchase order is in force.
alternate_courses: If the allotment available is not enough, the head of the budget unit does not sign Box B (cohorts P and E), or BTMS blocks the obligation (cohort B) [GAM-V1 Ch.3 s.15][BTMS-SITE]

name: Accept the delivery and record the payable
goal: The delivery is inspected and accepted, and the payable is in the books.
alternate_courses: A partial delivery is recorded as partial on the acceptance report [GAM-V2 App.62] | For a lawful advance, a security replaces the accepted delivery (atlas diagram 00d, t4b) [IRR12009 s.71.2.5] | Goods returned: goods return note in BTMS (cohort B) [CL2025-8]

name: Examine and approve the claim
goal: The voucher is certified and approved for payment within the cash authority.
alternate_courses: If the NCA balance is not enough, the voucher is kept until cash is available [GAM-V1 Ch.6 s.12] | If a supporting document is missing, Box C (documents complete) is not certified [GAM-V2 App.32]

name: Pay the payee
goal: The payee is credited, and the bank is replenished from the Treasury Single Account.
alternate_courses: If the bank cannot credit an item because branch, account name or number do not agree, the entry is invalidated; the agency reverses its entry, lists it in the next summary list and issues a new payment order [GAM-V1 Ch.6 s.54, ss.44-45] | Payment by MDS check with the advice of checks issued and cancelled [GAM-V2 App.39] | Agencies with sub-accounts at the Land Bank may send the order through eMDS [eMDS]

name: Record, report and audit the payment
goal: The payment is in the books and registries, the taxes withheld are remitted, and the auditor has the paid documents.
alternate_courses: Taxes withheld are remitted by the 10th day of the next month through eFPS [GAM-V1 Ch.6 ss.60-62] | The auditor may issue an observation or a notice of suspension, disallowance or charge [COA2009-006]

name: Reconcile with the bank
goal: Books, registries and bank agree for the period.
alternate_courses: Reconciling items are listed in the bank reconciliation statement [GAM-V1 Ch.21 s.4] | In cohort B the reconciliation is daily from electronic statements (described, not verified) [BTMS-SITE]

name: Release an allotment
goal: The allotment is available to the agency, and its release document can be checked by any person.
alternate_courses: Items without pre-conditions: the GAA itself is the allotment order [NBC599 s.3.7] | Items that need clearance: Special Budget Request, and for some items approval of the Office of the President [NBC599]

name: Procure up to the award
goal: An award is made after a public notice, and the plan and report are with the GPPB.
alternate_courses: Bids through the electronic bidding facility or on paper [GPPB2025-09] | Procurement data to BTMS is planned (cohort B) [CL2025-8]

name: Collect a fee and deposit it
goal: The fee is in the books of the agency and its cash reaches the Treasury Single Account.

name: Collect taxes and duties
goal: The return is posted, the goods are released, and the collections reach the Treasury Single Account.

name: Borrow through government securities
goal: The proceeds are in the Treasury Single Account and the debt is recorded and serviced.

name: Report on budget execution
goal: DBM, COA, BTr and the public receive the reports.
alternate_courses: Agencies on BTMS: reports produced from BTMS records [CL2025-8] | Until migration: reports through URS or other electronic means [GAA2026-GP]

name: From the investment program to the enacted budget
goal: The enacted budget is in the systems of DBM and can be released.
alternate_courses: Projects that need appraisal go to the ICC and the ED Council (diagram 01b, optional block) [AO37]
